d:
Ghar mein sabzi nahi? Sirf 2 tarah ki mirchi se banayein 2 sabzi, bina pyaaz lehsun
Aaj Masala Kitchen mein Poonam Devnani aapko sikhayengi Bharwa Mirchi aur Dahi Wali Mirchi ki sabzi. Aloo ki filling wali mirchi sarson ke tel mein seki, aur patli mirchi dahi ke masale mein pakayi.
Aloo bharwa mirchi: chhanni mein aloo mash karne ki trick
Sarson ke tel ki smell aur tikhapan hatane ka tarika
Dahi wali mirchi ki sabzi: roti ke saath sukhi ya chawal ke saath rasedar
Bina pyaaz lehsun ki sabzi, 2-4 din fridge mein rakhkar bhi khayein
